name: How long does a typical closet remodel project take with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical closet remodel project take with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a closet remodel project with Maine Results, Inc. varies based on the scope and complexity of the design. A smaller reach-in closet renovation might be completed within a few days, while a large, custom walk-in closet with intricate features could take several weeks from initial design to final installation. The process begins with a consultation and design phase, followed by material ordering and then installation. Timely decision-making on design elements and materials can help keep your project on schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary by complexity; smaller remodels might take days, while larger custom designs could take several weeks from design to installation.
